Our prayers are with Erika Kirk and her and Charlie's children today.  

Our country lost a patriot, a voice and a leader, but they lost a husband and father. 

Psalm 127:3–5  "Children are a heritage from the Lord, offspring a reward from him. Like arrows in the hands of a warrior are children born in one’s youth. Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. They will not be put to shame when they contend with their opponents in court."

We are praying for the loved ones, fellow deputies, and everyone at the Charleston County Sheriff's Department grieving the loss of Deputy Michael Hendricks, who was killed in a line-of-duty tragedy yesterday.

Deputy Hendricks put on the badge to protect this community, and he gave everything doing it. 

May God give his family strength, peace, and comfort in the days ahead.

Rest in peace, Deputy Hendricks. Your sacrifice will never be forgotten💙

The internet broke after Carlos Alcaraz took off his shirt following a U.S. Open match.

SportsCenter posted the crowd’s response, women reached for their phones, and we discovered a remarkable new rule: the sexualization of a young athlete is only offensive when the athlete is female and the audience is male.

You don't get to condemn the male gaze and then celebrate the female one.

Real men protect women. Real women protect men.

Read the full op-ed: https://t.co/A0KYDRDRdA

25 years.

It has been 25 years since radical Islamists flew planes into the Twin Towers on September 11, 2001, carrying out the most prolific act of terrorism on American soil. 9/11 was more than an attack on buildings. It was an attack on freedom, on faith, and on the very soul of our country.

2,977 innocent American lives lost. First responders, FDNY, NYPD, Port Authority, EMS, and civilians.

In the darkest of times, through the greatest of losses, America did not fall. It never will.

God
